explanation: From main: vite.config.ts gates VitePWA on VITE_SERVICE_WORKER (selfDestroying when unset, full Workbox config kept for opt-in); deploy:cf and deploy:cf:dry run build instead of deploy:dist, so precompress is now Apache-only; verify_deploy treats the app sidecar yardstick as optional on the edge model. Delivery, development, guidance and release docs and the catalog describe this. From this branch: the catalog's statistics area now names the shared FDR / p < 0.05 listing toggle and references listingModeStore.ts, and the generated AGENTS.md map line follows it; the UI-change runbook names the listing mode, TierLabel and QTerm as the shared pieces for significance tables.
